title: Usage aggregation and quota computation
goal: Aggregate raw usage into per-workspace period counters, compute quota state against entitlement limits (80 and 100 percent), feed usage into the entitlements object, and serve the usage summary endpoint.
scope_in: Worker job `usage.aggregate` folding usage_event rows (and relay-side counters relay_bytes, queue_items) into usage_counter(workspace, period_start, metric) with <= 60 s lag, idempotent by high-water mark.
Metric mapping to entitlement keys: agent_minutes -> agent_minutes_month, tokens_in + tokens_out -> tokens_month, queue_items -> queue_items_month; relay_bytes informational only.
computeQuota(workspaceId, now): per limit {used, limit, pct, exceeded} with null = unlimited and pct = floor(used*100/limit); crossing detection for 80 and 100 stored once per period per limit.
Period resolution: entitlements.period when subscribed, else calendar month UTC; rollover starts fresh counters.
On a new crossing: write quota_state, bump entitlements rev through B069 bumpRev, and emit a QuotaCrossed domain event {workspace, limit, pct, resets_at} for B076.
UsageReaderPort implementation for B069 (usage fields and warnings[]) and GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/usage/summary.
scope_out: Sending sys.notice and notifications on crossings: B076.
Ingestion and validation of events: B074.
Enforcing the 100 percent block on queue approvals, new agents and REST creates: B080 and the relay.
Pricing or overage billing (none in v1).
build_against: Postgres container seeded with usage_event rows via factories, fixed clock, fake EntitlementService (B069 interface) with plan fixtures from contracts/fixtures/entitlements/, fake RelayCounterPort.
interfaces: QuotaService.compute(workspaceId, now): Promise<QuotaState>  // {period:{start,end}, items:{key:'agent_minutes_month'|'tokens_month'|'queue_items_month', used:number, limit:number|null, pct:number|null, exceeded:boolean}[], warnings:{limit:string, pct:80|100}[]}
QuotaService.check(workspaceId, key): Promise<{allowed:boolean, retryAfterS:number|null}>  // used by B080

Tables usage_counter(workspace_id, period_start, metric, total bigint, pk(...)), quota_state(workspace_id, period_start, limit_key, crossed_80_at, crossed_100_at), usage_aggregate_cursor(id pk, high_water timestamptz)
Relay counter port: RelayCounterPort.take(workspaceId, metric): Promise<number>
acceptance: Ingesting 3 000 agent_minutes events across a month, then running the aggregator twice, yields a counter equal to the exact sum; the second run changes nothing (idempotent).

Limit 6000 agent_minutes: used 4799 -> pct 79 and no warning; 4800 -> pct 80 and exactly one warning entry and one QuotaCrossed(80); 6000 -> pct 100, exceeded=true and QuotaCrossed(100); further usage emits no more events in the period.
tokens_month counts tokens_in + tokens_out; limit null returns pct null, exceeded false and never emits crossings; limit 0 with used 0 returns pct 0, used > 0 returns exceeded true.
A crossing bumps entitlements rev exactly once (spy on bumpRev) and GET entitlements then lists the warning with the right limit key and pct.
At the period boundary instant (period.end) counters for the new period start at 0 and previous period state is kept for history; quota_state is per period so a crossing can recur next period.
Aggregation lag: events ingested at t are visible in QuotaService.compute within 60 s in the integration test using the real job schedule on a fake clock.
Pooled Team usage: events from 3 users of one workspace sum into one counter; summary endpoint by a workspace member returns 200, by a non-member 404.
Summary and entitlement `usage.seats` equals seats in use from B030's port (stubbed) and not the Stripe quantity.
A late event with `at` in the previous period increments the previous period's counter, not the current one.
tests: usage.aggregate.test.ts: idempotency, high-water mark, late events
usage.quota.test.ts: thresholds, null/zero limits, property test on random event streams
usage.period.test.ts: subscription period vs calendar month, rollover
usage.crossing.test.ts: once-per-period emission and rev bump
usage.entitlements-integration.test.ts: usage and warnings in entitlement object
guardrails: MUST aggregate idempotently: a crash and rerun must never double count (use the high-water mark inside the same transaction as the counter update).
MUST NOT block, delete or modify raw usage_event rows; counters are derived and rebuildable from them.
MUST emit each 80/100 crossing at most once per (workspace, limit, period).
MUST treat entitlements as authoritative for limits; MUST NOT read Stripe or plan names.
LAN and local usage MUST never be counted or blocked: only hosted-session events carry a session_id the backend knows.
failure_modes: Aggregator crash mid-run -> transaction rolls back, high-water mark unchanged, next run redoes the same window.
EntitlementService bumpRev fails -> quota_state is not marked crossed (same transaction boundary or retry), so the crossing is retried next run.
Relay counter source unavailable -> client-reported metrics still aggregate; relay-derived metrics are skipped and retried, flagged by a metric.
